text:
oliver: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — centralizing owners for the dry-restore, routing circuit-breaker, and game-day checklist. I want one tracker row per item so we can close PRs.

oliver: Items to assign: 1) table-level dry-restore job + artifacts, 2) routing circuit-breaker thresholds and revert steps, 3) DNS TTL + canary sequencing, 4) game-day runbook and comms.

mei: I'll take the dry-restore job. Plan: monthly job that restores last full snapshot to staging, runs schema diff + checksum on customer tables, then uploads validation report. ETA: 1816080000.

raj: I'll own the routing circuit-breaker. I'll add a pre-failover capacity check and a throttle that aborts failover if GPU util > 70% or concurrent streams > 1200. ETA: 1816150000.

infra-bot: backup-dry-restore last_run=1815920000 status=success artifacts=/srv/artifacts/backup-1815920000.tar.gz

mei: Security note: staging should not contain raw PII. security-team, can you confirm masking rules? I'll include a scrub step in the pipeline.

security-team: Confirmed. Provide sample scrub rules in PR and request a security review. We can approve scoped creds for pipeline once PR exists.

oliver: @mei add the exact IAM roles required to the runbook so reviewers can provision short-lived keys.

mei: Will do. I'll include example IAM least-privilege policy and how to request short-lived credentials.

raj: Routing playbook will include a smoke test snippet: ```for i in 1..5; do curl -sf https://api.eu.example.com/health || exit 1; done``` and a revert command to re-weight DNS by region.

oliver: Good. For DNS TTLs, let's standardize: 30s for fast failover, but use weighted canary steps (10%, 50%, 100%) with 2-minute pauses. Any objections?

mei: 30s TTL is OK for internal endpoints; public CDN frontends need longer. I'll document per-class TTLs.

raj: During the postmortem we saw flapping when we failed over under high load. I'll add a cooling period lock so we don't attempt two failovers inside 10 minutes.

oliver: Tracker doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/dr-followups-2026 — please comment to ACK and set due_ts. I'll mark rows in tracker "assigned" once you ACK here.

mei: ACK "dry-restore job + scrub pipeline" assigned. due_ts=1816080000

raj: ACK "routing circuit-breaker + cooling lock" assigned. due_ts=1816150000

security-team: We'll review the scrub PR when opened. Also: if test artifacts land in S3, enable MFA delete for the artifact bucket.

infra-bot: scheduled_job reminder: backup-validator will run 1816083600

oliver: Also planning a 2-hour mini game-day on 1816220000 to validate runbooks and automation. Volunteers: DB ops (mei), routing (raj), observers (oncall).

mei: I'll run the restore and measure RTO.

raj: I'll run the routing steps and be on-call for rollback.

oliver: Thanks — please update the tracker when PRs are open. If you hit blocker on permissions ping @security-team or #eng-infra. Closing thread for now, will reopen if any owner changes. :white_check_mark:
